# Edgard Vargas

Edgard Vargas is the Director General and founder of Bridge (Bridge Studio), a software, data, and digital marketing studio based in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. He founded Bridge in 2013, while still in a university environment. He studied Diseño para la Comunicación Gráfica at Universidad Guadalajara Lamar (generation 2010-2014).

He is the voice and the criterion. Bridge is the studio that builds.

## What he leads

Edgard leads the conversation on artificial intelligence inside mid-size and large companies in Mexico: where AI belongs, what not to touch, and who owns the number. Bridge executes: automation, agents, and data-driven decisions inside the operation, not as a disconnected demo.

## Bridge

Bridge has delivered more than 300 digital projects for government, business organizations, and private brands, with work in Guadalajara, Mexico City, the United States, and Canada. Layers: software, digital marketing, and unified data.

## Selected work under his direction

- Vive Pueblos Mágicos, CONCANACO SERVYTUR. Brand and digital platform for Mexico tourism. National prize in technological innovation.
- Camino a Qatar, AT&T México. National loyalty activation. 80,000 users in three months.
- Museo Juan Gabriel, Ciudad Juárez. Immersive experience with digital reservations, AR, and audio. More than 10,000 active users.
- Helvex. Native sales catalog and commercial operations app.
- Arqademy. Native app with AI for 30,000 students.
- Universidad de Guadalajara: Butaca, digital credential, and La Gaceta.

## Awards (Bridge / product)

- 2013: Premio Nacional en Innovación Tecnológica para la Promoción Turística (CONCANACO SERVYTUR and INADEM), Vive Pueblos Mágicos.
- 2013: Reto Zapopan and Retos Públicos SEGOB.
- 2020: Dental Delivery among the 100 best apps, Startup Istanbul.
- 2025: Best Mobile App Developer, recognition of Bridge as a mobile product partner in Mexico.

## How to engage

- Work with Bridge: product, data, marketing, AI inside the company. Email edgard@bridgestudio.com.mx with subject "Trabajar con Bridge".
- Invite Edgard to speak: conferences on where AI enters a company that already operates, why pilots never reach the ERP, and what to ask a vendor before signing.
